# Aloof

> The self-driving cloud for backends. Deploy a repo (public or private) or a Docker image; Aloof keeps it running. AI agents deploy, debug and scale over MCP. Billed per second in USD.

## What Aloof does (live today)
- Self-healing deploys: auto-rollback when a new release raises errors or latency. Covers apps with enough traffic in the 5 min after deploy (>=100 requests, >=10 bad requests from >=3 IPs); can be turned off per app. Health-gated deploys and one-command rollback for everyone.
- Replaces instances that fail health checks; routes traffic away from failing instances.
- Autoscaling and scale to zero (idle apps cost nothing; volumes still bill).
- Managed Postgres 16 with daily backups (7 kept); volumes; custom domains with TLS; private networking; workers, cron, release commands.
- Private repos and private registries; GitHub App push-to-deploy and previews.
- Region: Nuremberg, Germany (single region). Backups: Helsinki, Finland.

## Coming soon (NOT live)
GPUs (waitlist), more regions, predictive scaling, auto right-sizing, AI auto-fix, deploying onto your own VPS.

## MCP server
Remote: https://mcp.aloof.si/mcp (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, dynamic client registration; tokens revocable anytime).
Local (stdio): {"mcpServers":{"aloof":{"command":"python3","args":["mcp_server/server.py"],"env":{"ALOOF_API_URL":"https://api.aloof.si","ALOOF_API_KEY":"pk_..."}}}}
Source: https://github.com/sachinchandra/aloof-mcp (MIT)

### Install
- Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http aloof https://mcp.aloof.si/mcp
- Codex CLI: codex mcp add aloof --url https://mcp.aloof.si/mcp
  or ~/.codex/config.toml:
    [mcp_servers.aloof]
    url = "https://mcp.aloof.si/mcp"
- Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json or .cursor/mcp.json): {"mcpServers":{"aloof":{"url":"https://mcp.aloof.si/mcp"}}}
- Claude.ai / ChatGPT / other clients: add https://mcp.aloof.si/mcp as a custom connector.

### Tools (25)
inspect, list, signup, deploy_app, deploy_template, scale_app, set_env, rollback_app, set_self_heal, exec_command, destroy_app, add_domain, verify_domain, remove_domain, create_volume, attach_volume, detach_volume, create_postgres, attach_postgres, backup, restore, add_log_drain, add_credential, create_deploy_token, join_gpu_waitlist.
- inspect(what=status) returns requested_release vs serving_release, health, mismatch and a plain warning when a newer deploy failed while an older one still serves.
- deploy_app(wait=true) blocks until the deploy finishes; ok=false if the new release failed.
- inspect(what=diagnose) is read-only: recent errors, failed health checks, deploys, rollbacks, restarts, exit codes (e.g. 137 OOM) and likely fixes, secrets redacted.
- Legacy tool names: add ?tools=legacy to the endpoint.

### Scopes (enforced in MCP server and again in API)
- paas:read: look only (inspect, list). Cannot deploy, change, delete or spend.
- paas:write: deploy, scale, env/secrets, domains, volumes, databases, deploy tokens. Cannot destroy_app, restore, delete volumes/databases/snapshots, or change login, API keys or billing.
- paas:admin: full access. Legacy `paas` = paas:admin. Clients that request no scope get full access (Authorize page warns); users can always grant lower.
- New deploy tokens cannot destroy unless created with --allow-destroy.
Docs: https://www.aloof.si/docs/mcp#scopes

## CLI quickstart
curl -fsSL https://api.aloof.si/cli/aloof -o ~/.local/bin/aloof && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/aloof
aloof signup you@company.com     # or: aloof login
aloof deploy my-api-1234 --image nginx:alpine --port 80
App names are global (served at https://<name>.aloof.si). App must listen on $PORT (default 8080). CI: set ALOOF_API_URL and ALOOF_API_TOKEN (deploy token).

## Pricing (USD, per second; monthly = always-on 30 days)
Tiers: Free $0 (includes $1/mo usage, never billed: apps pause at $1; 3 apps, 256MB/512MB, sleep after 5 min idle) · Hobby $5/mo (includes $5 usage, up to 50 apps) · Pro $20/mo (includes $20 usage, unlimited apps, 1 seat, no SLA). New accounts: $5 prepaid credit.
Instances: shared-1x-256mb $1.99 · shared-1x-512mb $3.49 · shared-1x-1gb $5.99 · shared-2x-2gb $11.99 · shared-4x-8gb $44 · perf-1x-2gb $24 · perf-2x-4gb $59 · perf-4x-8gb $119 · perf-8x-16gb $239
Postgres: pg-dev $2.99 · pg-basic $9.99 · pg-standard $28.99 · pg-perf $60.99
Volumes $0.22/GB-mo · egress $0.06/GB · backups/snapshots $0.22/GB-mo · inbound, custom domains, TLS free.
